savings.title: How the System Works

day.title: Daytime
day.desc: When the sun is shining, your roof works for you. Solar panels supply your complex with electricity. Surplus daytime energy is sold on the exchange, with the option to buy it back for use at night.

night.title: Nighttime
night.desc: When the sun sets, the system smoothly switches to battery power. This significantly reduces electricity costs for common areas at night. Daytime generation can also be directed to cover the night-time shortfall, delivering round-the-clock savings.

savings.currencyNote: * Calculations are based on electricity tariffs in Turkish lira; all amounts are shown in TRY.
savings.disclaimer: * Calculation based on PVGIS solar irradiation data for Turkey (35° tilt, south-facing), an electricity tariff of ₺5.50/kWh including taxes, and full self-consumption from the battery. Actual savings depend on regional weather conditions and consumption habits.

panels.title: CW Enerji Tier-1 Panels
panels.description: Premium Turkish CW Enerji Tier-1 solar panels with advanced TOPCon technology, made of special anti-glare, self-cleaning glass with high efficiency and minimal degradation.

inverter.title: TommaTech Hybrid Inverter
inverter.description: TommaTech hybrid inverters provide full control over energy distribution between solar panels, the central grid, battery storage and the building's load, ensuring maximum efficiency and reliability for common areas.

battery.title: TommaTech High-Voltage Lithium Battery
battery.description: TommaTech high-voltage energy storage systems are modern modular batteries based on safe lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) technology. They are designed to work with three-phase hybrid inverters, supplying the complex with energy during voltage surges, sudden power outages and grid interruptions.
battery.stats_note: At up to 90% depth of discharge
